title: Law to create a 3-digit gun violence help hotline
summary: This bill would require the city's gun violence prevention office to set up a 24/7 three-digit hotline connecting callers with mental health, counseling and other support services. The office would also have to run a public awareness campaign aimed at young adults and report annually, starting April 1, on call volume and the hotline's effectiveness. The new law would take effect 120 days after being enacted.
